title: Auditing with CloudTrail & Config
summary: AWS CloudTrail records who called which AWS API, when and from where: Event history for 90 days, trails to S3 and Athena for long-term audit, data and Insights events, log file integrity validation and EventBridge rules that react to specific API calls. AWS Config records resource configurations over time, checks them against managed or custom rules, remediates violations with Systems Manager Automation and aggregates results across accounts and Regions. Ends with how to choose between CloudWatch, CloudTrail and Config.
